description: Ministry of Transport & Highways - The National Thoroughfares (User Fee) Regulations No.1 of 2021 - Amendment assigning Toll rate For Kurunegala to Yaggapitiya.
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Transport and Highways under the National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008, specifically amending user fee rates for different vehicle categories on national thoroughfares. This constitutes legal/regulatory content involving statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
